facts.why: The scoreboard prints the Alpha Betas scoreless in every round of the Greek Games. The nerds win overall, but the sources describe a contest the nerds win on ingenuity, not a shutout, and the numbers are really the layout's dish count. As printed it reads as a game score the film never shows.
facts.fix: Relabel the rows so they are not a score: ROUND to STALL, TRI-LAMBS to PIES SOLD, ALPHA BETAS to KISSING BOOTH
facts.applied_text: STALL / ON THE MENU / PIES LEFT
facts.applied_note: Rows relabelled ON THE MENU and PIES LEFT instead of PIES SOLD and KISSING BOOTH: no opened page says the Alpha Betas ran a kissing booth, and a zero under PIES LEFT reads as sold out, not a score.
